# BCGov Crow - v0.15.0

## Release type

Minor release

## Summary

Added a CI pipeline agent and one modular CI skill for Java and .NET
applications using GitHub Actions, Azure Pipelines, and Jenkins.

## Highlights

- Assess existing CI and troubleshoot build, test, audit, and quality-gate
  failures across all three supported providers.
- Inventory classic Azure build and release pipelines, analyze available
  definition details, and author new Azure YAML pipelines; create Declarative
  Jenkinsfiles rather than treating Jenkins as a YAML provider.
- Route shared Java/.NET checks through existing application-development
  guidance. Keep internal SonarQube on approved trusted runners; public
  GitHub workflows may use SonarQube Cloud under its current terms.
- Add existing unit, integration, and automated UI suites to CI by default,
  and package applicable database changes without deploying them. Resolve
  the application's version when Sonar is part of the build.
- Include the agent and skill in the Starter Package. Align full-package,
  plugin, and collection versions at 0.15.0.
